arcs.title: The Six Remaining Ducks of Elspeth Holt
arcs.summary: Day 3: Steve visited the ridge and learned why Mrs. Holt hats ducks — bare ducks look cold, full stop — but also discovered a quieter reason: her late husband drove these same ridges, and she began leaving things on other people's vehicles afterward, 'just to be friendly.' Steve logged it under 'why we go.' Five ducks remain at the ridge, unscheduled. The deerstalker note ('This one is for the detective') is still unresolved; Lucy has not clarified. Day 4 should bring another duck — perhaps hand-delivered again, or with a note that nudges the 'detective' question toward resolution — and may begin to build toward whatever the final duck's arrival will mean: a completion, a small ceremony, or simply Mrs. Holt on the porch with the last hatted duck and nothing more to say but everything said.
